claimType: exploratory representation study on already-exposed U3b rooms with previously unused deterministic target frames; not confirmatory efficacy evidence
motivation: U3/U3b showed that calibrated uncertainty predicts metric sensor error but does not robustly improve TSDF geometry through scalar weighting. U3c showed median scalar-fusion leverage is zero in every room. U4a showed hard uncertainty support gating has topology leverage but over-prunes valid geometry, worsening Chamfer in all five rooms. U5a therefore preserves all sampled observations and moves calibrated uncertainty into the continuous Gaussian covariance of each surface primitive rather than into TSDF averaging or deletion.

representation.name: uncertainty-shaped Gaussian surfels
representation.sourceViews: reuse the exact eight frozen U3b source timestamps per scene
representation.sourceDepth: CA-1M onboard ARKit wide/depth in metres
representation.sourceConfidence: exact prepared ARKitScenes uint8 confidence sidecar; shuffled control uses the exact frozen shuffled sidecar only for sigma

sampling.rationale: bounded deterministic CPU reference workload; each sampled Gaussian represents one 4x4 source-pixel cell

representation.center: back-project the sampled metric depth at its integer source pixel and transform with the frozen camera-to-world pose

covariancePropagation.pixelStandardDeviation: pixelStride / sqrt(12), modeling a uniform source-cell footprint independently in u and v
covariancePropagation.jacobian: J = dp/d[u,v,z] evaluated at the sampled observation
covariancePropagation.gaussianEncoding: symmetric eigendecomposition of worldCovariance; eigenvalues become squared scales and a deterministic right-handed eigenbasis becomes GraphDECO wxyz rotation

opacity.rationale: fixed across all methods so only covariance changes; the reference rasterizer's existing alpha cutoff and 3-sigma footprint remain unchanged

representation.color: constant zero-order SH payload; color is not evaluated

methods.sigmaZ: calibratedSigma with frozen shuffled confidence while centers remain unchanged

targetViewSelection.purpose: representation-native metric geometry evaluation on views not used to seed Gaussians
targetViewSelection.completeFrameDefinition: timestamp has CA-1M wide/depth, gt/depth, and gt/RT
targetViewSelection.exclude: all eight frozen U3b source timestamps
targetViewSelection.ordering: ascending timestamp over remaining complete frames
targetViewSelection.indexRule: for i in 0..7 choose floor((2*i+1)*N/16) from N eligible frames; require N>=8 and eight unique indices
targetViewSelection.faroTarget: CA-1M gt/depth at each selected target timestamp
targetViewSelection.faroInvalid: zero/non-finite depth ignored exactly as independent target invalidity
targetViewSelection.targetIntrinsicsAndPose: use the target frame's released CA-1M intrinsics and FARO-registered pose

renderer.depthDefinition: existing first-contributing Gaussian center depth after front-to-back sort

evaluation.unit: scene; each scene summary aggregates its eight deterministic target views
perTargetView: rendered finite depth count on FARO-valid pixels
fraction of FARO-valid pixels rendered within 0.05m
fraction of FARO-valid pixels rendered within 0.10m
evaluation.scenePrimaryDescriptiveMetric: mean across eight target views of fraction of FARO-valid pixels rendered within 0.05m
evaluation.secondary: mean target-view coverage and overlap MAE/median/p95
evaluation.candidateVsDepthOnly: candidate scene primary metric minus depth-only scene primary metric
evaluation.shuffledDegradation: candidate scene primary metric minus shuffled scene primary metric
evaluation.warning: all intervals are descriptive because room identities were already exposed by U3b/U3c/U4a

mechanismInterpretation.promising: calibrated covariance improves held-out FARO depth correctness in multiple rooms relative to depth-only and shuffled covariance without suppressing observations, motivating a fresh untouched U5b confirmation
mechanismInterpretation.noEffect: depth-only, calibrated, and shuffled covariance are nearly identical, implying the current rasterized Gaussian footprint has insufficient sensitivity to externally calibrated metric uncertainty
mechanismInterpretation.worseCoverageOrError: calibrated covariance enlarges uncertain splats in a way that increases foreground leakage/occlusion or hurts metric depth; do not tune sigma clipping on these rooms and do not open U5b for this exact rule
mechanismInterpretation.shuffledNotWorse: do not attribute any apparent gain to calibrated confidence association

confirmatoryBoundary.futureU5bRequirement: only if U5a is mechanistically promising, freeze a new untouched-room set and all representation/evaluation constants before asset exposure

literaturePositioning.note: Recent sparse-view Gaussian work increasingly introduces uncertainty, depth, visibility, or Bayesian structure into Gaussian reconstruction. U5a is deliberately narrower: it propagates an externally calibrated consumer-depth error model into explicit Gaussian covariance, preserves every sampled observation, performs no image-driven optimization, and evaluates metric held-out depth against independent FARO targets.
